pages.title: Prime Shard
pages.text: A sliver of a number divisible only by one and itself. Primes are the atoms of arithmetic: every whole number factors into them in exactly one way. In the Platonic Realm they grow wild in irregular clusters; out here they must be sieved. Each shard is sharp-edged and refuses to split.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first found these crystals scattered in the Platonic Realm's vaults and in the debris of Axiom Sentinels. Later I learned to sieve them out of a natural number lattice with a quantum processor, Eratosthenes style, discarding every multiple.

Made in $(item)Sieve of Eratosthenes$() and $(item)Quantum Computer$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Prime Number Ore$(), in veins through the Platonic Realm.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Axiom Sentinel.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Euclids Vault, Hilbert Archive chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Formal Logic.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cipher Loom, Error-Correcting Code, Modular Form, Octonion Crystal, Riemann Zeta Crystal, Warm Helium.
